title: Portfolio X-ray
sub: How the simulated holdings are spread, and how this mix would have moved in past periods.

window.label: Period
window.unavailable: Not enough price history for this period.

band.title: Against your risk profile
band.note: The limit is the one the watchlist applies to single assets for your risk profile. It is the app's own band, not a regulatory threshold.

valueRisk.title: Where the value sits, and where the risk sits
valueRisk.sub: Each holding's share of the portfolio's value, next to its share of the risk in this period.
valueRisk.lead: {symbol} is {value} of the value and {risk} of the risk.
valueRisk.leadNovice: {symbol} carries {risk} of the ups and downs with {value} of the money.
valueRisk.notAvailable: The replay never moved, so the risk cannot be split.
valueRisk.more: {count, plural, one {+ # more holding} other {+ # more holdings}}

move.title: How this mix would have moved
move.sub: Today's proportions applied to every day of the period, indexed to 100 at the start.
move.chartLabel: Replay from {from} to {to}: starts at 100, ends at {last}. Worst fall {pct} from {peak} to {trough}.
move.yourAnswer: You answered "{answer}" to the 20% drop question. In this replay the mix fell {pct} from its peak.

together.title: Moves together
together.sub: Pairs of holdings whose daily moves were most alike (1 means identical).
together.none: Needs at least two holdings with price history.
together.ratioNote: 1.0 means the holdings added no cushion against each other; higher means they offset each other more.

whatIf.title: Test a change
whatIf.sub: See the X-ray before and after a hypothetical change. Nothing is traded or saved.
whatIf.scenarioNote: Scenario: simulated only. Nothing is traded or saved.
whatIf.conflictsTitle: Where this meets your profile filters
whatIf.noConflicts: No conflict with your profile filters.
whatIf.heldOnly: Only held assets can be reduced.
whatIf.noCash: No simulated cash left to add.

limits.title: Limits
limits.scenario: Today's proportions are applied to every past day: this is a scenario, not what the simulated portfolio earned.
limits.priceOnly: Price changes only: dividends and fees are not included.
limits.currency: Returns are in Canadian dollars; US prices are converted at the Bank of Canada rate of each day.
limits.notForecast: Past behaviour does not predict future results. Simulation only, not advice.
limits.coverage: This period covers {share} of the portfolio's value. Left out for lack of history: {list}.
limits.unpriced: No price right now, so not included: {list}.

states.loading: Reading the holdings and their price history…
states.error: The X-ray could not be loaded: {error}
states.empty: The portfolio holds only cash. The X-ray appears once a simulated position exists.

novice.summary: {symbol} is the biggest position, at {share} of the portfolio.

card.finding: {symbol} is {value} of the value and {risk} of the risk.
card.spread: The risk is spread about as the value is.

page.title: Portfolio X-ray
page.loading: Reading the holdings and replaying them over their price history…
page.explainMessage: Explain this X-ray: what stands out over the period shown, and where each figure comes from.

obs.title: What stands out
obs.sub: Plain readings of the numbers above, chosen by fixed rules. They describe the portfolio; they are not advice.
obs.risk_gap: {symbol} is {value} of the value but {risk} of the risk in this period.
obs.above_band: Volatility of {vol} is above the {limit} limit of your risk profile.
obs.near_band: Volatility of {vol} is close to the {limit} limit of your risk profile.
obs.few_holdings: The money is spread over about {count} equal-sized positions.
obs.close_pair: {a} and {b} moved closely together ({corr}), so they added little cushion to each other.
obs.currency: {share} of the portfolio is in US dollars, so its value also moves with the exchange rate.
obs.cash_heavy: {share} of the portfolio is cash, which adds no growth and no risk in this replay.
obs.little_cushion: The holdings offset each other little (diversification ratio {ratio}).
obs.left_out: {list} could not be included in this period for lack of history; {share} of the value is covered.
